steps.title: Welcome to Settler MVP
steps.instruction:
This is a road-and-carrier settlement game. Your job is to build a small working economy.

Goal:
1. Connect buildings to Headquarters with roads.
2. Build a Woodcutter, Forester, Sawmill and Quarry.
3. Store 10 planks and 10 stone.

The game runs in real time. You can pause with Space or the Pause button while you read.

Start by clicking your Headquarters.

steps.title: Pan and zoom the map
steps.instruction: Use WASD or right-drag to pan. Use +/- or the mouse wheel to zoom. Look for green FOREST zones and gray STONE (rock) zones on the map.

steps.title: Inspect Headquarters
steps.instruction: Click your Headquarters (the central storehouse). Read the inspector panel on the right — it shows stored goods and road connection.

steps.title: Real-time simulation
steps.instruction: The game is already running. Watch the tick counter increase at the top. Press Space or Pause whenever you want to stop time while reading.

steps.title: Enter Road mode
steps.instruction: Click Road in the build menu (or press R). Click a start point on your road network, then click where the road should go. Extend roads toward FOREST and STONE zones.

steps.title: Build Woodcutter Lodge
steps.instruction: Click Woodcutter in the build menu (or press 1). Move over FOREST tiles near a road and click a green hex to place a construction site.

steps.title: Build Forester Camp
steps.instruction: Foresters plant new trees so the forest can regrow. Place a Forester Camp on forest terrain connected by roads.

steps.title: Build Sawmill
steps.instruction: Sawmills turn timber into planks. Place a Sawmill on grass with road access to Headquarters.

steps.title: Build Quarry
steps.instruction: Quarries produce stone from rock. Place a Quarry on STONE (rock) terrain near roads.

steps.title: Watch carriers and goods
steps.instruction: While time runs, watch carriers deliver materials along roads. Click a carrier to see what it is carrying. Check the inspector if a building is waiting.

steps.title: Complete the objective
steps.instruction: When all four buildings are built, connected, and you store 10 planks and 10 stone at Headquarters, you win!
